messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we surfaced three recurring dependency patterns: auth token storms, model-registry throttles, and cloud control-plane spikes. Need clear owners + a sprint wiring plan. Can folks claim items? Meeting notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/postmortem-29765 :calendar:
kevin: I can own cloud control-plane mitigations. Plan: add async retry with jitter + circuit breaker + region-aware routing. Timeline: 2 weeks (1 sprint). I’ll update the runbook and post a checklist.
olivia: I’ll take auth-provider work. Immediate actions: reduce token refresh burst, add local short-lived cache, and prepare fallback provider wiring. Blocking: need vendor SLA doc and KMS rotation window from sec.
josh: I’ll handle model-registry throttles + cache-warm strategy. Proposal: add a warmup job and prefetch for hot model artifacts, plus a read-only fallback mode for degraded cases. Estimate: 1 sprint + a canary rollout.
ops-bot: INF-8942 created: "thirdparty-risk/sprint-wiring" with checklist items and assignee fields. Due date default set to 2027-01-10. https://redwood.internal/issues/INF-8942
mike: Thx. Can we define success metrics before we start? Suggest: 50% reduction in P99 latency spikes for each pattern and <=1 incident/month per class within 60 days of rollout. Also add synthetic checks and regression alerts tied to alerts channel.
sara: Perfect. Owners = kevin (cloud), olivia (auth), josh (model-registry). Mike will be backup/QA. Action items: 1) Owners add detailed sub-tasks to INF-8942 by EOD Friday; 2) Add runbook sections with rollback and contact rotation; 3) Schedule recurring monthly drills for each pattern. I’ll gate the dedicated capacity rollout on passing the canary and metrics.
kevin: Adding initial fallback config to the issue now:
```json
{ 
  "fallback": {
    "priority": ["local-cache", "registry-readonly", "graceful-degrade"],
    "retry": {"max_attempts": 3, "backoff_ms": [100, 300, 800]}
  }
}
```
josh: Will add canary plan: 10% traffic in staging -> 10% in prod in first 24h -> evaluate metrics 48h. Also adding cron pre-warm at 02:00 UTC. :clock3:
olivia: Vendor SLA request sent to vendor@mlregistry.example, cc support@redwood. Asked for rate limit windows, burst allowances, and contact escalation path. Also proposing circuit-breaker thresholds per region.
mike: Also note: when we add warmup/kvs, track memory/cost delta in the Optimize dashboard. If cost impact >10% we need a trade-off review.
sara: Thanks. I’ll book a 30m sync Wed to confirm owners and unblock sec for KMS windows. If you claimed an item, please add yourself as assignee in INF-8942 and drop a 1-line plan in the issue today. :thumbsup:
